_what: offline/multishine manifest: the compat profiles compile exactly the file set, flags and link order of the existing stage build scripts ( step a/b). 'stage' maps a virtual path (the path the file has in its stage directory, so relative includes resolve unchanged) to the copy under offline/multishine; 'external' lists canonical library files used in place (not copied).

sites.doc: S11 allocation-site tables (sd_sites/st_addr/st_site, 88 KB) and the cold-site/site-profile code. Product default off (RC1 contract cold=0 site_prof=0): compiled out; 'sites=on' is the lab build ( step 1). Image 1 / textonly card and the heap probe since the mainline (offsets the package R glue growth in the card holes; their contracts set neither cold nor site_prof).

s17-compat-om.doc: Image 'Multishine online-menu': the s17-compat blob plus offline/multishine/menus/om/om_backend.c (console-local answers for Slippi's online title menu; s12_gc.c is compiled with -Dsdshim_set_backend=om_set_backend, the copied file is not edited); plus om_heap.c / om_heap_stub.S (AllM/HSD heap boundary of the online major scene, 04 hook at 0x80015900); plus codehist.c / om_card.c (direct-code history on the memory card)

s17-compat-od.doc: Image 'Multishine online-direct': s17-compat-om with a real Direct mode. od_backend.c replaces om_backend.c (B4 -> od_glue.c -> the server over wire v2, B3 states and refusal texts, engine answer once the session runs); the engine glue s12_gc.c and the S7 core are COPIES WITH EDITS (glue/s17od, net/s17od: marked OD, diffs listed in ONLINE_GLUE section 6): the server step in the network slice, route by source address, s7_core_set_peer, B5 field offsets and lock-in ready flags (-DOD_SELECT_LOCK); client library mnc/mw2/mw2_crypto/ms_sha256 used in place; the heap policy and the code history are the online-menu image's

s17-compat-on.doc: Image 'Multishine online': s17-compat-od (Direct through our server, code history, heap policy, Teams-fixed codeset) with on_backend.c in place of od_backend.c: Ranked and Unranked rows through the server, the server setup and identity read from the memory card file MultishineOnline (on_card.c #includes on_hist.c, the fork of om_card.c with the slot policy: one translation unit shares the card work area; on_cfgrec.c parses the record), and the Ranked result report (BD -> GAME_REPORT, evidence from od_core_final in the s12_gc.c copy under -DON_BUILD). od_glue.c / mnc.c carry the additive report and card-config functions. Hold B for 3 s to leave the CSS, with the hint and the bar (menus/on/on_bhold.c + on_bhold_sis.S, called from s3_tick_body under ON_BUILD; AllM shift 0x5C000 for its ~3 KB; 10.9).

s17-compat-ond.doc: Image 'Multishine online' (diagnostic: on-screen card status, -DON_DIAG): s17-compat-od (Direct through our server, code history, heap policy, Teams-fixed codeset) with on_backend.c in place of od_backend.c: Ranked and Unranked rows through the server, the server setup and identity read from the memory card file MultishineOnline (on_card.c #includes on_hist.c, the fork of om_card.c with the slot policy: one translation unit shares the card work area; on_cfgrec.c parses the record), and the Ranked result report (BD -> GAME_REPORT, evidence from od_core_final in the s12_gc.c copy under -DON_BUILD). od_glue.c / mnc.c carry the additive report and card-config functions. Hold B for 3 s to leave the CSS, with the hint and the bar (menus/on/on_bhold.c + on_bhold_sis.S, called from s3_tick_body under ON_BUILD; AllM shift 0x5C000 for its ~3 KB; 10.9).

s17-compat-hil.doc: LAB ONLY (offline/hil/patches/README.md): s17-compat + the hardware-in-the-loop dev link. Build with MS_HIL_DEV=1 in the environment (build_s17_net.py then adds the pad hook `bl hil_padread_stub` at 0x80376A24). Needs build/hil/hil_cfg.h (hil_host.py gen-header: dev key, host address). Never exported, never a release or online profile.

s17-compat-ml.doc: Image 'Multishine menu layout': the s17-compat-om blob plus offline/multishine/menus/ml (ml_core.c table rules, ml_glue.c Melee glue: Main Menu with the maintainer's rows, Miscellaneous screen, label overlay; ml_stub.S: four 04 hooks at mnMain_Scene_OnEnter, mnMain_Scene_OnFrame, the label call and the entry of mn_8022B3A0; ml_table.h generated by tools/menu_layout.py cheader)

cardwa.doc: CARD work area + block buffer (40,960+8,192 B). 'ext' (default, ENGINE_MEMORY_BREAKDOWN step 2b): ONE area shared by on_card and sbr_card and NOT in the image: with -DMS_CARD_WA_ADDR=<addr> (card route, offline/cardloader/card_payload.py) it is the loader's own work area above the claimed hole, else (patched/ISO route) 48 KB from the HSD heap per card operation (OSAllocFromHeap, refusal = card busy). 'shared' = step 2a (one static area in the image, ms_card_wa). 'separate' (any other value) = the old layout, two static areas.

sites.doc: S11 allocation-site tables (sd_sites/st_addr/st_site, 88 KB) and the cold-site/site-profile code. Product default off (RC1 contract cold=0 site_prof=0): compiled out; 'sites=on' is the lab build ( step 1).

hgtrace.doc: LAB ONLY ( B): count the engine writes after the match scene ended (sd_melee.c scene_gone, sd_core.c sd_hg_w) and report them at the first pass of the next scene (S6!K HGON / HGRG). 'nofix' is the negative control: the engine keeps writing after the scene change as before the fix (reproduces the post-match CSS corruption). Release builds keep it off: no sd_hg_ symbol exists.

itemsall.doc: LAB ONLY (docs/design/ITEM_SOAK_2026-10-28.md): od_rules sets S7R_ITEMS_ALL for every match of the build (all items on, frequency 4), so the pair rig / stage smoke can soak items without a Game Night room. Release builds keep it off (tools/release/check_release_shape.py).

rbread.doc: DEV/LAB ONLY (R1, B0): the post-game CSS readout of the last match (store size and heap, capacity peaks, cell_overflow, lost_ranges, HSD and AllM free / minimum; s12_gc.c rbr_*, on_bhold.c rbr_tick). Release builds keep it off: no rbr_ symbol exists. 'rt': the same code compiled in but OFF until the card's Options file (Settings > System > Rollback readout) switches it on (s12_gc.c rbr_enable); 'on' = always on (lab).

labnat.doc: DEV/LAB ONLY: the hub client accepts an opponent whose address equals the server's when od_cfg flag bit 5 is set (server and seat behind one NAT). Release builds keep it off: peer_addr_ok then always refuses the server's address and the flag bit does not exist.

netcfg.doc: DEV/LAB ONLY: the bridge reads the net-config section of MultishineBridge from the card. Release builds keep it off: sbr_netcfg.o is then empty and no sbr_nc_ symbol exists.

menuovl.doc: Menu code as an on-demand overlay (ENGINE_MEMORY_BREAKDOWN step 3 7). 'flat' (default): ml_core / ml_glue / sg_ovl / sg_hook resident, byte for byte the build before the overlay existed. 'ovl': only the resident remainder of ml_glue.c, ml_res.c (dispatchers, loader, scene hook) and sg_ovl.c stay; the rest is linked flat by menus/ml/ml_ovl_pack.py into the file ms/menu.ovl (the disc, or the ISO builder's MS_DISC_EXTRA); if the file cannot be read or entered the retail menu runs unchanged.

brprobe.doc: Bridge peer probe ( D1). 'out' (default): the second ENet host struct sbra.P (19,928 B at REL_DATA 512, 10,676 B at MAX_PEERS 1) and the probe code are compiled out (-DSBRA_NO_PEER_PROBE for sbr_app and br_glue): the product hand-off (cfg flags 0x20, SBRA_F_ENGINE_PEER) never runs it, a lab mode without the hand-off and without the stub fails the peer step at once. 'in': the lab variant with the probe (flags without 0x20/0x10).

brpeers.doc: Peer table of the bridge's own ENet copy (BRIDGE_HUB_REUSE.md D2). '1' (default): -DSDENET_MAX_PEERS=1 for every bridge unit that sees struct sdenet_host (sbr, sbr_app, sbr_card, sbr_ident, sbr_netcfg, sdenet_br, br_glue): the matchmaker host only ever has the one outgoing peer (a second peer slot existed for the probe's simultaneous connect). '2': the old size. The engine's own ENet copy (sdenet.o) is never touched.

brslots.doc: Reliable and hold slots of the bridge's own ENet copy (BRIDGE_HUB_REUSE.md D3). '8' (default): the library default. '4': -DSDENET_REL_SLOTS=4 -DSDENET_HOLD_SLOTS=4 for the bridge units (4,424 B per host at REL_DATA 512): the matchmaker traffic has at most the 2-fragment ticket, a ping and a disconnect in flight. Opt-in until the console has run it (build_rc.sh / build_cvr_image.sh --opts brslots=4).

s17-compat-onb.doc: Image 'Multishine online + layout + Slippi bridge': s17-compat-on (our lab server, the rollback engine, code history) plus the maintainer's menu layout (menus/ml, unchanged sources, ml_stub.S with ml_unlock_override renamed to br_unlock_override) plus the Slippi bridge (offline/bridge/sbr*.c used in place, a second ENet object sdenet_br with fragments and a 512-byte reliable payload, sddns) living on the online glue's network stack (offline/bridge/br_glue.c; s12_gc.c compiled with -DBR_BUILD, on_backend.c with -Dsdshim_set_backend=br_set_backend so that the finished Multishine backend is wrapped by the dispatcher). The hub rows of the layout use the Multishine backend, the Slippi row (kind 8) the bridge.

s17x.doc: Lab / opt-in config flag bits of the rollback engine and its glue: s17_flags beyond G|H|U + SKIPCAP (LOGZ, DD, HPF, U_OLD, U2, NEG_*, FORCE_BUSY, NODCBST in the engine; CENSUS, CHAIN*, PE, PACE*, RELAX*, NOGUARD in the glue), s12_flags beyond 0x20304E, s10_flags beyond 0x101, every s16_flags bit, s3 flags / s6d_flags, s6c_flags beyond 2: never set by the release contract (s17_flags 0x40000007, s12_flags 0x304E, s10_flags 0x101). payload.py refuses a contract that sets any other bit unless s17x=on. Product default off: the engine and glue read the words masked to the contract bits and the dead code is compiled out. s17x=on keeps every bit for lab builds and rig runs that set them.

fp.doc: S12 fingerprint capture (S11/S16 fp_*, sd_fp_check, cmp_range_fp fingerprint paths). Product default off: with s17_flags G (RC1 0x40000007) sd_init forces sd_fp to 0, so the code is dead in a release; compiled out. fp=on keeps it for lab builds that run fp captures (s17_flags without G).

edfast.doc: Ed25519 verification by a joint binary-NAF double scalar multiplication (offline/client_net/mw2_crypto.c 5): 4,843 field multiplications instead of 10,252, +248 B of code and +672 B of stack in the engine. Used by the engine's signature check of MultishineOvl (df_glue.c, once per boot); the sign-in overlay takes the same switch (SG_EXTRA_CFLAGS=-DMW2_FAST_VERIFY) for the Update download check. 'off' (default): the ladder, byte for byte the build before. Differential test: offline/client_net/tests/test_ed_fast.py.

nosched.doc: Post-register-allocation instruction scheduling off (-fno-schedule-insns2): scheduled code is less compressible, so the MSLZ stream shrinks while the blob size stays the same. 'menu': only the menu / online / bridge / pack-glue units (never the rollback engine, the network slice, the EXI shim or the hot loops of the CRC, MSLZ, SHA and Ed25519 code); about -2.4 KB of stream. 'all': every unit including the rollback engine (about -7.1 KB; the rollback owner must judge the codegen change, hardware only). 'off' (default): byte for byte the build before.

hubovl.doc: Hub/online client as an on-demand overlay (ENGINE_MEMORY_BREAKDOWN step 4 6.5). 'ovl' also builds the update check on the title (-DUPD_TITLE 'Check on title': hub_res.c loads the overlay on the title while the check is wanted, hub.ovl's tchk asks the server, START opens the Update offer; Settings > Online > Update check at start turns it off at run time). 'flat' (default): od_glue / mnc / mw2 / ms_sha256 and all of on_backend.c resident, byte for byte the build before the split. 'ovl': the resident keeps the hand-off (od_take_peer, od_core_report, od_rx, od_b3, the error texts), the B3 / BA answers, the state blocks and menus/hub/hub_res.c (loader, scene policy, thunks); od_glue's search / report / DNS logic, mnc, mw2, ms_sha256 and the B9 / B4 / BE / BD answers are linked flat by menus/hub/hub_ovl_pack.py into ms/hub.ovl, an entry of the signed MultishineOvl card file (menus/hub/hub_pack.py), loaded in the main menu and on the online character select and freed at every scene change; without the file the Multishine rows say so and the retail and Slippi menus are unchanged.

bootrec.doc: OTA automatic rollback, engine side: the build counts its own start in the boot record of MultishineState from the first title / menu frame whose card layer is idle (br_glue.c br_tick -> upd_host.c upd_boot_frame) and marks itself good at the first Main Menu frame (ml_stub.S ml_frame_stub -> upd_boot_menu). Without it a build that hangs after the loader is never counted and only L+R recovers. 'on' (default): upd_host / upd_card (boot-only ops: no delete, no rename, no room check) / ota_core (bootrec_*) are linked, about 2.5 KB. 'off': the earlier image (the units are linked but nothing references them, the linker drops them).

tlsprobe.doc: DIAGNOSTIC, LAB ONLY, never in a release: the engine hands the sign-in overlay its sdnet (struct built with SDNET_ENABLE_TCP=1: +56 bytes of hooks) and the resident network helpers, so a lab sign.ovl (SG_LAB=1, SG_TLSPROBE=1) can run the TCP + TLS 1.3 probe of offline/net/tls/hil/sdprobe.c on the console in the menus. 'off' (default): the code is not compiled and the image is byte-identical to a build without the option.

repovl.doc: Slippi game reports from the console (; needs hubovl=ovl, the card route). 'on': the resident keeps the report queue and counters (menus/rep/rep_q.c, rep_res.c, about 4 KB: `struct rep_keep`, the weak hooks of br_glue.c) and loads ms/rep.ovl (menus/rep/rep_ovl_pack.py, an entry of the signed MultishineOvl container, hub_pack.py --rep-ovl) into the HSD heap only while a report is due in a main-menu scene and OUR server announced HELLO capability bit 15 to this console (per console on the server, default off: no console setting). struct sdnet is built with SDNET_ENABLE_TCP=1 (+56 bytes of hooks) and the TLS helper accessors of s12_gc.c are compiled (shared with the lab TLS probe). 'off' (default): none of it is compiled and the image is byte-identical to a build without the option.

qchat.doc: QUICK CHAT: the D-pad chat of Slippi's online character screen. menus/qc/qc_gc.c (drawing, pad, sounds; a port of the lab image offline/chat/gc/chat_gc.c) + offline/chat/chat_core.c / chat_link.c (rules, wire, window, subtitle queue, used in place) + the transport in s7_core.c (0x84 in, s7_core_chat_tx out, the engine's own ENet session) + the session/tick glue in s12_gc.c (qc_pump) + one line in on_bhold.c (no hold-B exit while the window is open). 'off' (default): none of it is compiled, the image is byte for byte the one without the option (the extra units are empty). 'on': the feature. 'demo': LAB ONLY, also the single-console test mode of the lab image (every preset, the notice, the window pages, a worst-case line, one step per 150 frames, no pad input). The overlays must be built with the same option (struct s3_core grows by 12 bytes).

flashblank.doc: EVENT MATCH FLASH FIX, in the release recipe since release candidate 477: when the pending major scene becomes 8 (Slippi's online character screen) while the running major is not 8, on_bhold.c bh_tick (the engine's per-frame tick) calls VISetBlack(1) + VIFlush so the hub's last Event Match frame is not shown during the scene load, and lifts it when the new major scene runs (not loading) or after 1.5 s at the latest (time base, wrap safe). 'off' (default): nothing is compiled, the image is byte-identical.

hubdiag.doc: DIAGNOSTIC, LAB ONLY, never in a release (Game Night post-match return hunt): the hang-locator ring (gns_bc, events of the hub loader and the uploader block), the hub loader's early-return reasons and two compact state lines on the character screen (UP ring, B result-report state), drawn every 4th pass without any other readout.  rbread=on/rt includes it.  'off' (default): nothing is compiled, the image is byte-identical to a build without the option.

livediag.doc: DIAGNOSTIC, never in a release: after a live match ends (or while a scene loads for more than 10 s) the engine paints seven rows of status words into the frame buffers: why the match ended (ENet timeout, peer disconnect, stall rule, ...), the stall / ENet / packet counters, the bridge state and, when a scene is stuck loading, where the game thread is (srr0, lr, return addresses). Never painted during a match; reads RAM words only (offline/bridge/ld_diag.c, livediag.h). 'off' (default): the unit is empty and sbr_app.c has no call, the image is byte-identical to a build without the option.

rbtest.doc: TEST ONLY, NEVER SHIPPED: 'hang' makes the engine hang in its first frames right after its start was counted in the boot record, i.e. a validly signed build that never reaches the Main Menu, to prove the automatic rollback with the real engine in Dolphin and on the console. tools/card/build_card.sh refuses it without --dev. Build such a file only under a throw-away --name and publish it only into a private update directory.

s17-compat-onbc.doc: Image 'Multishine card route RC1': s17-compat-onb plus the disc-file pack (offline/multishine/menus/df: three hooks on Melee's file funnel DVDConvertPathToEntrynum / lbFile_8001634C / HSD_DevComRequest serve changed or added disc files from the memory-card file MultishinePack, so that the game disc can stay stock). Only the card contract multishine-card-rc1.json uses it; every other image is unchanged.
